notes:
- New speech service: Modulate, the lowest price per hour. Read its data-use note before you choose it.
- **Modulate may train on the audio you send unless you opt out with them.** Its key window and its row in the list say so in amber, with a link to what Modulate says, and the first time you make it your notes engine, your live transcript or your dictation, A9 Voice asks once: **Use Modulate** or **Cancel**. It is never part of the free setup, and Savings shows its price without a verdict: no **Best value**, no **Good fit**, no **Could save**.
- **Notes and the live transcript on one key.** After the call each side goes up in parts, with speaker labels on the other people's side and your Dictionary as custom terms (**Velma Multilingual**, about $0.03 an hour; **Velma English Fast**, $0.025, English only and without the Dictionary). Live uses the English stream when **Language you speak** is English, else the multilingual one, about $0.10 and $0.12 an hour for both sides. Modulate allows three requests at a time per model, so a busy moment waits and tries again instead of failing your note.
